reveal.onceWarning: Copy it now. It is shown only this once and cannot be retrieved later; if you lose it, revoke it and mint another.
reveal.copyFailed: Could not copy. Show the secret and copy it by hand.

orphan.failed: A credential minted after you cancelled could not be revoked ({{label}}). Its secret was never shown, but it stays usable until it is revoked.

problem.unusableScopes: The server refused these scopes: some would grant nothing given the others. Add the scopes they need or clear them.
problem.templateOffHost: The server refused the allowlist: every template must be active on one of the selected hosts. The lists have been refreshed.
problem.notFound: It no longer exists or was already revoked. The list has been refreshed.
problem.changed: Something changed while this was in progress (for example, the host was removed). The list has been refreshed; try again.
problem.invalid: The server rejected these settings. Check them and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.generic: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
problem.webhooksRequireAllOwned: The server refused webhooks:write: it needs a key over all owned resources and all usable pools.
problem.credentialsUseNeedsLogins: The server refused credentials:use: a restricted key must name at least one login.
problem.agentLimit: You already have 10 active agent tokens. Revoke one before minting another.
problem.agentExpiryPolicy: This expiry isn't allowed on this server. The choices were refreshed; pick one again.

draft.nameTooLong: Use at most 120 characters for the name.
draft.unknownHost: That host is no longer available. Choose another.
draft.unusableScopes: Some selected scopes grant nothing on their own. Add the scopes they need or clear them.
draft.noTemplates: Choose at least one template on a selected host.
draft.unknownTemplate: A selected template is not available on the selected hosts.
draft.unknownPool: That pool is not in the loaded choices. Reload the picker or choose another pool.
draft.webhooksRequireAllOwned: webhooks:write needs All owned resources and All usable pools, because an endpoint receives events for every sandbox on the account.
draft.credentialsUseNeedsLogins: A key restricted to selected resources needs at least one login when it has credentials:use.
